name: Claymation

style_block.visual_characteristics: Visible clay sculpting, tactile fingerprints and surface variation, soft miniature-set lighting, carefully modeled facial likeness
style_block.application: Transform the rendering style of the subject from the reference image, maintaining a recognizable identity and consistent scene composition.
style_block.adaptation_rule: Only stylize appearance and rendering. Allow the geometric simplification inherent to this style while keeping the original visual relationships and intent.
style_block.avoid: Avoid melting anatomy, unrequested props or replacing the environment.

reference_rule: Use the subject from the reference image. Do not introduce new people, props, text, or logos.
